research_object.title: REMoDNaV: Robust Eye Movement Detection for Natural Viewing
research_object.scope: Numerical results, figures and manuscript, including explicitly linked runtime code/data/environment components. Exported eye-gaze files are inputs; regenerating original acquisition data from lab-source repositories is not required.

S-01.rationale: Root README, registered data/implementation modules and container configuration expose the components used for numerical analysis, figures and manuscript. Relationships are explicit in code and build targets. The upstream local-path raw-source module is outside the runtime input inventory; the exported eye-gaze files are the actual inputs.

assessments.comment: Independent inspection-only assessment using frozen manifest e3c6253bced7d959cd59873c3d49d166bf5793906bcdf65e49e265076d215499 (remodnav-e3c6253bced7). Source text, histories, inventories, annex availability metadata and a supplied linked adapter were inspected. Only read-only Git tag inspection was run, with GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1. No network requests, payload acquisition, scientific execution or image builds occurred. Historical exit codes are supplied records, not independent reproduction. Binary data, SVG payloads and container layers are absent from the evidence cohort; content/route judgments do not claim successful retrieval or visual correctness. Root instructions overstate full rerun coverage: quality_stats and flowchart fragments are not in the executable CLI. All 36 native criteria receive explicit anchor judgments; completion of this inspection does not establish computational reproducibility or validated research quality.
